decimals_probe.control_rationale: Each check names a subject that DOES return an answer from the same endpoint. Without one, an empty result and a broken or unreachable endpoint are the same output, and the comfortable reading — that the tool is at fault — is the wrong one here.

checks.result: marker resolves; carries no denom_units or exponent
checks.control: same shape returned for every denom queried

checks.result: empty net_asset_values for all four denoms
checks.control: nuva.helocplus returns 1 entry, so the endpoint is live
endpoint returns 200 with an empty list, not an error

decimals_probe.what_would_resolve_it: An issuer-published exponent per marker (bank denom metadata, a marker attribute, or a marker net-asset-value), or a documented unit from Hastra/Figure. ⚠️ Do NOT infer it by fitting the balances to a plausible pool size — a fitted exponent is a guess that reads as a measurement, and the error is a power of ten.
decimals_probe.blocked_figure: Composition of the Democratized Prime pool by collateral class. The classes held are known; their relative sizes are not.

warehouse.loan_vs_ylds_note: This account is the Democratized Prime pool contract: the YLDS is the pool's un-lent supply and the .forge tokens are pledged loan collateral. Loan-token decimals are unresolved, so no cross-unit ratio or USD value is derived.
warehouse.loan_quality_caveat: Public scope records expose hashes, not permissioned loan payloads; delinquency, LTV, FICO, cure rate, and loss severity are unobservable.
warehouse.marker_semantics_caveat: Loan tokens are issuer-minted Provenance markers. Chain consensus verifies that they exist and move; it cannot verify that a unit corresponds to a real, performing, correctly-valued loan. Scope records are hashes with payloads in a permissioned store.

securitization.source_caveat: ABS-15G filing cadence is a public securitization proxy.

yield_realization.target_apy_note: The issuer rate floats with facility utilization and is read live from Hastra's pulse API on the same trailing-24h NAV basis we measure. A fixed level is never the alert basis: when the live read is unavailable the configured fallback populates the tile but the divergence alert is suppressed.
yield_realization.basis_note: PRIME appreciation is additional wYLDS received on unstaking. Hastra states that staking replaces the separately claimable wYLDS baseline yield, so the wYLDS rate is not added again.
yield_realization.source_caveat: Issuer-administered NAV is a lagging directional symptom, not an independent impairment measure.

heloc_credit.risk_parameters: Figure Portfolio Manager manages risk of accounts secured by real estate-backed loans pledged to this pool. Loans are pledged to a warehouse facility for use as collateral in Democratized Prime. Borrowing in this pool is over-collateralized by the unpaid balances of these loans discounted at an advance rate. All loans 60+ days delinquent will be removed from the collateral pool.
footnotes: *WA (weighted average): Averages are weighted by current unpaid principal balance, so loans with more outstanding count for more. A handful of large balances can pull a weighted average well away from the typical loan.

figure_delinquency.basis: (30+ days delinquent + forbearance) / total UPB, loans held for sale

peg.nav_basis: PRIME market price normalized at wYLDS par versus the Solana Chainlink stake-price config (wYLDS per PRIME); wYLDS/USD moves are excluded from the canonical premium/discount

usd_conversion.basis: Secondary context only: wYLDS per PRIME multiplied by PegTracker's live wYLDS/USD price

liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: The on-chain Uniswap V3 QuoterV2 ladder reaches the PRIME/USDC pool's observed counter-token inventory ceiling before a size-responsive 2% crossing can be located. Output stops increasing with requested size, so this capacity figure bounds available USDC inventory rather than 2%-slippage depth; it must not receive a liquidity band or be divided by supply.

exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: ALL-IN COST against notional: (output_usd - size) / size. Includes the venue's base spread, so it is not comparable rung-for-rung with a price-impact figure measured against a venue's own spot rung.

liquidity.note: Executable depth and the capacity ceiling are Ethereum-only: the PRIME→USDC exit is capacity-capped before 2% slippage. Solana (Orca PYUSD/PRIME) is covered in the venue table for TVL and volume, but no capacity ceiling is established there—the aggregated router quotes are non-monotonic and cannot identify saturation. The two venues are separate exits with different counter-tokens and must not be added together. USDC liquidity is campaign-supported by Hastra PRIME Roots and may not persist. Per-pool 24h volume is sourced from the GeckoTerminal indexer, not an on-chain read, and is unscored.

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Provenance receipt claims plus direct YLDS ($598.9M) / total wYLDS supply ($598.1M). ⚠️ This measures the WRAPPER, not the underlying: PRIME is a wYLDS-denominated vault share, so what stands behind it is FCC's certificate reserve, and that reserve's own coverage is NOT in this feed. It comes from an UNAUDITED interim 10-Q and is the figure that actually bounds this one — a fully-covered wrapper over a thinly- covered reserve still reads ~100% here. ⚠️ Read the reserve's composition before trusting this number: its coverage can improve while the reserve SHRINKS, because the denominator falls with it.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: Provenance receipt claims plus direct YLDS minus wYLDS supply — the same two figures as collateral_ratio, so backing/(backing - surplus_deficit) recovers it. Positive here, unlike apyUSD's and USDm's, so the junior-capital question actually bites. ⚠️ WHETHER A SUBORDINATED LAYER SITS INSIDE IT IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT ASSERTED EITHER WAY. What this feed can say: PRIME and wYLDS have no tranche of their own, so nothing junior exists at the WRAPPER level. What it cannot say: the reserve holds redeem vault receipt claims on Figure's AUTOYLDS and HEYLDS loan pools, and the Democratized Prime warehouse has $420.9M of certificates lent in — whether our claims are senior or subordinated INSIDE those pools is a fact about Figure's structure that nothing in this feed measures. TO ESTABLISH IT: the warehouse facility's capital structure, or FCC's ICA §28 qualified-asset detail.
